objective: Replace the synchronous 'audit' table insert in handle_transfer (ledger/api.py) with a bus.publish on topic 'audit' in the frozen 5-field format, isolate publish failures so the handler still returns {'ok': True} for a valid transfer, and adjust tests/test_ledger.py so TestApi asserts the publish flow instead of the direct audit row.

concepts: in-process pub/sub: subscribe/publish, in-order delivery, V1 subscriber-exception propagation
handler-level isolation of publish failures (try/except around bus.publish)
backward-compatible wire format: event key set exactly AUDIT_EVENT_FIELDS

non_goals: changing the values of AUDIT_EVENT_FIELDS or AUDIT_TOPIC (C1)
changing the transactions row shape, its ordering before the publish, or the bad-amount rejection (C2)
adding dependencies, threads, or a queue (A-1, DA-1)
implementation_constraints: stdlib only; unittest style matching tests/test_ledger.py
the transactions insert stays first and unchanged; bus.publish happens after it
isolation: wrap the bus.publish call in try/except Exception and still return {'ok': True} on a raise — no re-raise, no response-shape change (A-2)
update the handle_transfer docstring to describe the new publish flow (the legacy comment is removed)

deliverables.what: publish path + publish-failure isolation in handle_transfer
adjusted TestApi: publish-spy test, isolation test, bad-amount no-event test; TestStore/TestBus/TestWorker unchanged

acceptance_tests.description: handle_transfer returns {'ok': True}; a spy subscriber on 'audit' captures exactly 1 event whose key set equals set(AUDIT_EVENT_FIELDS) with values matching the transfer arguments; with no subscriber the 'audit' table stays empty and the 'transactions' table holds exactly 1 row
an audit subscriber that raises RuntimeError leaves handle_transfer returning {'ok': True} with the transactions row written and no exception escaping the handler
amount <= 0 returns {'ok': False, 'error': 'bad-amount'}; the spy captures 0 events and no transactions row is written

failure_cases.scenario: bus.publish raises because a subscriber raised during delivery
failure_cases.expected_behavior: the handler swallows the exception and returns {'ok': True}; the transactions row is already in the store because the insert happens before the publish

handoff.notes: T04 exercises this publish path end-to-end; the isolation behavior (C2) is gate E2. The only existing test changed is TestApi.test_transfer_ok_and_audit_written, rewritten to subscribe a spy/consumer — the task explicitly moves audit persistence off the request path.
